items.title: Ernest 'Punch' Miller Interview, 1959-09-25
items.q: one boy named Charlie Calloway, we was playing, I was playing with the same shooting... Charlie Calloway, colored boy, he was the MC on the show

ctx.x: Yeah. And he just walked out. They couldn't catch him, you know. Yeah. Joe told me about that.
I think the only white boy was with us in that coat was Charlie. Charlie, wasn't it Charlie?
